snapshot.text: Public and church-run health system with one of the world's highest HIV and TB burdens, and dependence on South Africa for specialist care. Lesotho completed its second Joint External Evaluation and restructured its health ministry.

priorities.title: Health security
priorities.text: A second Joint External Evaluation assessed health security capacities.

priorities.title: Tuberculosis
priorities.text: A national TB Parliamentary Caucus was launched.
